SELECT tta.defencePressureClass
FROM "Team_Attributes" tta
WHERE tta.team_api_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT home_team_api_id FROM "Match"
    WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM "League" WHERE name = 'England Premier League')
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT away_team_api_id FROM "Match"
    WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM "League" WHERE name = 'England Premier League')
)
GROUP BY tta.defencePressureClass
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tta.team_api_id) = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) FROM (
        SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_api_id FROM "Match"
        WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM "League" WHERE name = 'England Premier League')
        UNION
        SELECT away_team_api_id AS team_api_id FROM "Match"

)

WITH pl_teams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT home_team_api_id AS team_api_id
    FROM "Match"
    WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Premier League')
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT away_team_api_id
    FROM "Match"
    WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Premier League')
),
team_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM pl_teams
),
class_counts AS (
    SELECT ta.defencePressureClass,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ta.team_api_id) AS team_cnt
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    JOIN pl_teams pt ON ta.team_api_id = pt.team_api_id
    GROUP BY ta.defencePressureClass
)
SELECT defencePressureClass
FROM class_counts, team_count
WHERE team_cnt = team_count.cnt;

SELECT DISTINCT ta.defencePressureClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE (m.home_team_api_id = ta.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = ta.team_api_id)
    AND l.name = 'England Premier League'
)
ORDER BY ta.defencePressureClass

WITH premier_teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT home_team_api_id AS team_id FROM "Match" WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM "League" WHERE name = 'England Premier League')
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT away_team_api_id FROM "Match" WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM "League" WHERE name = 'England Premier League')
),
team_class_counts AS (
  SELECT ta.team_api_id, ta.defencepressureclass
  FROM "Team_Attributes" ta
  JOIN premier_teams pt ON ta.team_api_id = pt.team_id
  WHERE ta.defencepressureclass IS NOT NULL
),
class_team_counts AS (
  SELECT defencepressureclass, COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) AS team_count
  FROM team_class_counts
  GROUP BY defencepressureclass
),
total_teams AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM premier_teams
)
SELECT defencepressureclass
FROM class_team_counts, total_teams
WHERE team_count = total;

FROM Team t

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean the number of goals scored by each team in the England Premier League during the 2010/2011 season, so I want to see for every team in that league how many goals they scored that season, broken down by team.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT t."team_long_name" AS team_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m."home_team_api_id" = t."team_api_id" THEN m."home_team_goal"
                ELSE m."away_team_goal" END) AS total_goals
FROM "Match" m
JOIN "Team" t ON (m."home_team_api_id" = t."team_api_id" OR m."away_team_api_id" = t."team_api_id")
JOIN "League" l ON m."league_id" = l."id"
WHERE l."name" = 'England Premier League'
  AND m."season" = '2010/2011'
GROUP BY t."team_api_id", t."team_long_name";

    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_11 FROM Match WHERE home_player_11 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_1 FROM Match WHERE away_player_1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_2 FROM Match WHERE away_player_2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_3 FROM Match WHERE away_player_3 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_4 FROM Match WHERE away_player_4 IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_10 FROM Match WHERE away_player_10 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_11 FROM Match WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
),
player_match_counts AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM match_players
    GROUP BY player_api_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 50
),
latest_rating AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) md ON pa.player_api_id = md.player_api_id AND pa.date = md.max_date
)
SELECT AVG(lr.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM latest_rating lr
JOIN player_match_counts pmc ON lr.player_api_id = pmc.player_api_id;
